; Provides: the functions of ...
abstraction ide.testMbit {
    capabilities {
    SELF E
    M_BIT_DEV RW
}
    method Status {; ============================================================
; TEST 6: M-authorized swap of CR12 and CR13, then swap back
;
; Requirements:
;   - CR6 must have S authority for SAVE
;   - CR6 must have L authority for SWITCH
;   - Rows 7 and 8 begin as canonical NULL rows
; ============================================================
; Load authority for the M-bit I/O word
LOAD    CR0, M_BIT_DEV
; Arm CR12.M and CR13.M:
;   bit 12 = 0x1000
;   bit 13 = 0x2000
IADD    DR1, DR0, #0x3000
DWRITE  DR1, CR0, #0
; Save the original isolated-register GTs.
; Each successful SAVE consumes its source register's M bit.
SAVE    CR12, CR6[7]
SAVE    CR13, CR6[8]
; Re-arm both M bits for SWITCH
DWRITE  DR1, CR0, #0
; Swap the registers
SWITCH  CR12, CR6, #8
SWITCH  CR13, CR6, #7
; Re-arm both M bits because SWITCH consumed them
DWRITE  DR1, CR0, #0
; Swap back to the original state
SWITCH  CR12, CR6, #7
SWITCH  CR13, CR6, #8
        RETURN
    }
